svg.aria-label: Architecture: reconkit.yml defines connections, checks and contracts; the Runner resolves each column pair to one canonical text form (resolve_columns), then the Bisector asks both databases, through their dialects, for bucket, row count and checksum, one GROUP BY per level, splitting only the buckets that disagree. Rows from mismatching buckets are downloaded and compare_rows applies tolerances and decides the differences. Contract checks run against the live table. Results go to terminal, JSON, JUnit XML and HTML reports and optional audit tables.

svg.text: Each database checksums its own rows. Only buckets that disagree are downloaded, and the local comparison decides.
